## Changes

### New
- Reader settings show only what applies: infinite scroll and the scroll speed in the vertical reader, Two pages in the sideways directions, and no page size or width while two pages are on screen.

### Fixes
- Desktop: the mouse wheel scrolls a chapter instead of zooming. Ctrl+wheel (⌘ on macOS) zooms around the pointer, and while zoomed the wheel moves the page.
- Sideways reading on a wide window: a page fitted to width is no longer cut off at the top and bottom; it scrolls down instead.
